label: Financial Evidence research previews
info: Click one Inject button, then inspect the Debug sidebar. Each click makes one bounded public GET. No timer, credentials, model, outbound message or trading action. Edit each Inject payload to choose a supported dataset, entity substring and limit (1–200). Synthetic is false for your research and must be true for operator/CI tests. Keep the full table with its sources, clocks, units, rights, missingness and partial state. MIT flow code does not grant source-data rights.

name: 1. Click one task • 2. Inspect evidence + warnings in Debug
info: Deploy does not fetch anything. Each manual click requests one page, never auto-follows pagination. The default bank is one currently covered institution, not universal bank coverage. BTC rows are indicative public research measures, not executable quotes or a validated composite.
